m1.typescript: m1 the user level holds a style a status line and a keybindings file that fit together

e1.typescript: e1 the style file keeps the coding instructions and carries only documented fields

e2.typescript: e2 the status line reads only fields the session sends and refreshes no faster than every second

e3.typescript: e3 the keybindings use real contexts and actions free keys and a null to unbind

e4.typescript: e4 personal settings stay in the user files and the project file stays shared

e5.typescript: e5 the local settings file is kept out of git

e6.typescript: e6 no file holds a personal path an address a key or an unfinished marker

wrong-style-name-case.defect: selects the style by a name that differs from the style file in its capitals, which silently gives the default style

wrong-status-command-outside-user-folder.defect: points the status line at a script that is not in the .claude folder of the user

wrong-style-drops-coding.defect: turns off the coding instructions of a style that only changes how replies read

wrong-style-field-misspelled.defect: misspells a front matter field, which Claude Code ignores without an error

wrong-status-field-unknown.defect: reads a field that the session JSON does not carry

wrong-status-refresh-zero.defect: sets a refresh interval below the one second minimum

wrong-key-reserved.defect: rebinds Ctrl+C, which cannot be rebound

wrong-key-context-case.defect: writes a context name in lower case

wrong-key-modifier-typo.defect: misspells a modifier in a keystroke

wrong-no-unbind.defect: frees no default key with a null binding

wrong-style-in-project-file.defect: puts the personal style in the shared project file

wrong-local-style-lowercase.defect: overrides the style locally with a name in lower case

wrong-local-file-tracked.defect: leaves the local settings file out of the ignore file

wrong-home-path-in-script.defect: writes a home folder path into the status line script

wrong-address-in-style.defect: writes an e-mail address into the style description
